schedule.freeze_policy: Freeze sources, labels, linkage, and protocol before the first measured run. Any later edit creates a new version.

decision.point_estimate_limits: Threshold crossings on this small fixed public development corpus are descriptive signals. The corpus and operator derivations are public and inspectable. Confidence intervals and per-provider-family denominators accompany point estimates; sealing, independent blind evaluation after publication, cryptographic runner attestation, and population-level generalization are not established.

cross_host_decision.aggregation_intent: Compute within-provider-family results first, then give OpenAI and Anthropic equal top-level weight.
